title: The Joy That Makes You Strong
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
The people gathered in one place
To hear the scriptures read.
Good Ezra stood up on the stand
And read what God had said.

[Chorus]
The joy of the Lord is your strength,
It makes your whole heart glad.
His words bring joy right to your heart
Even on days you're sad.

[Verse 2]
Some people cried, but leaders said,
"Today's a happy day!"
They dried their eyes and shared their food,
And joy chased tears away.

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
Now close your eyes, and let God's words
Fill up your heart tonight.
His joy will make you strong and glad
Until the morning light.

[Chorus]
mood: Gladness music. A warm, gently bouncing pulse moves under the voice, like a crowd leaning in to listen and then wiping away tears to share a feast. The chorus opens bright and full, the joy of the Lord filling the room. By the last verse the bounce softens to a slow rock, the pulse settles lower, and the gladness becomes a quiet, strong hum for sleep.
